ops.title: PR #1 (daemonkit v0.23.0) merged over a red CI/lint check
ops.body:
The daemonkit v0.21.4 → v0.23.0 bump landed as PR #1, merged 2026-08-27T02:52:34Z as de0ceac from branch 'deps-daemonkit-v0-22-0'. Its own pre-merge rollup was: CI/build SUCCESS, CI/integration SUCCESS, CI/cgo SUCCESS, CI/vuln SUCCESS, CI/lint FAILURE, Guides/pr-check SUCCESS, Socket Security SUCCESS (x2).

So yes — it merged over its own red check. The failure was purely gofumpt formatting debt already sitting on main (last green main CI before it: 1ca533a, 2026-08-17), not anything the PR introduced.

Two things this cost, worth remembering:

1. main stayed red for 12 days, so the red signal carried no information and the agent cutting v0.17.0 had to re-derive that from scratch before it could release.

2. golangci-lint's 'max-same-issues: 3' default caps issues sharing one message per linter. 'File is not properly formatted (gofumpt)' is one message, so the run reported 3 unformatted files when there were 4. Fixing the visible 3 (88883ad) surfaced the 4th (orchestrate/spawn_test.go), costing an extra red CI cycle. When clearing formatter debt here, enumerate locally with the version CI actually installs: golangci-lint-action pins 'version: latest', which was v2.13.2 on 2026-08-30 while the local install and the prek rev were both v2.12.2 — and the two disagree on which files are unformatted (v2.12.2's gofumpt flagged nothing at all). CGO_ENABLED=0 matters too: the lint job sets it so ptyhost/grid_cgo.go is excluded by build tag and no native libghostty-vt is needed; without it the prek golangci-lint hook fails on a missing libghostty-vt-static pkg-config.

Cleared by 88883ad + 7ed0a60; main's first green CI since 2026-08-17 is 7ed0a60.
